summary: Shinhan Financial Group filed a Form 6-K announcing its 2Q2026 earnings release conference scheduled for July 23, 2026, with a blackout period from July 9 to July 23. The filing provides logistics for a live-streamed earnings call with Q&A, including Zoom meeting details and availability of presentation materials online. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or management change. The registrant is Shinhan Financial Group as the issuer. No deal terms or material corporate actions are disclosed.
